test_title: SSC Stenographer 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 11 Dec, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in indirect speech.

Ram said, "I watched football."

options.text: Ram said that he watches football.
Ram said that he had watched football
Ram said that they watched football.
Ram said that I shall watch football.

solution:
Here is the solution in the requested HTML format:

```html
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indirect Speech:** Ram said that he had watched football.
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• **"I watched football" becomes "he had watched football"**
 
 
• Pronoun "I" is changed to "he" to match the subject in indirect speech.
 
• Verb "watched" is changed to "had watched" to reflect past perfect tense.
 
 
 
 
 
• **Reporting verb:**
 
 
• Remains as "said".
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *Ram said that he had watched football.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** Ram said that he watches football. 
 
 
• Tense is incorrect; it changes the past action to a present habitual action.
 
 
 
• **Option 3:** Ram said that they watched football. 
 
 
• Pronoun is incorrect; "they" does not match the subject "I" in the original statement.
 
 
 
• **Option 4:** Ram said that I shall watch football. 
 
 
• Tense and pronoun are incorrect; it changes the subject and tense of the original statement.
 
 

```
